description.narrative: The Project is expected to generate employment and value-added to the economy, support jobs and the livelihoods of farmers in Ukraine, and have climate mitigation effects through renewable energy generation and adoption. Beyond the Project, IFC investment is expected to contribute to promoting competitiveness of Ukraines soybean sector and broader agribusiness sector by pioneering a higher value-added soybean product and helping to catalyze the transition of Ukraines agribusiness sector from a commodity-driven sector to a value-added one.

The proposed investment is an IFC financing package of up to US$80 million to LLC Astarta Agro Protein, a subsidiary of Astarta Holding PL? (together, Astarta or the Company), to help finance the construction of a soy protein concentrate (SPC) production plant in central Ukraine (the Project). The Project is expected to be supported by Blended Finance, as described in the Blended Finance Section. Astarta is one of the leading integrated agricultural producers and processors in Ukraine, which operates crop growing, soybean processing, sugar production, cattle farming and milk production, and biogas production.
